rulings.restated: Subtract $0 from sd line 16. If zero or less, enter -0-.
rulings.model: The IRS line is 'Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment'; the restatement uses Schedule D line 16, which is not limited to property held for investment and can include other gains or losses.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f4952 (2025) p.3 Lines4d/4e restrict disposition amounts to property held for investment. The supported ScheduleD stream is manually classified securities and fund capital-gain distributions; sales.special refuses special/nonsecurities property and sd.other_forms refuses Forms4797/6252/4684/6781/8824 and K-1 gains. f4952.unsupported at line2 screens other investment income/expenses beyond interest, dividends and securities sales. Within this declared completed-return slice the ScheduleD totals/net-capital-gain helper are the investment amounts. The broader IRS cases are excluded; the ruling does not assert that arbitrary ScheduleD amounts from an excluded return are investment-property amounts.

rulings.restated: Enter the smaller of line 4d or sd helper "Nonnegative net capital gain for QDCGT".
